name: Strawberry Farms (an Orange County canyon in the dry season)
note: Course theme palette (<= 32 colours; same keys as pnw.json plus F0-F2). Strawberry Farms Golf Club, Irvine, from the developer's photos (release assorted-lidar-data, strawb.1-9) and NAIP: warm, yellow-green Bermuda fairways and tees; cooler, brighter bent greens; an olive rye rough (F0-F2); bright cream sand; the reservoir's blue; the brush of Sand Canyon Wash as dark olive-brown ground (G0-G2: woods); out of bounds, the coastal sage scrub of the hills in dusty olive, sage and tan (L0-L2); decomposed-granite tan paths. Trees in assets-src/trees_strawberry_farms.py: eucalyptus, Aleppo pine, sycamore, coast live oak and willow. Shadows are a 35% black overlay on top of these.
